top_p_on_wire_note: topP is a no-op at temperature 0.0 (greedy/deterministic) and is deliberately omitted from the Converse inferenceConfig, which carries only temperature and maxTokens. Declared and on-wire states are both recorded explicitly.
treatment_input_note: The model receives ONLY the frozen point-in-time-safe Item 6 treatment input (frozen prompt body + tool schema + per-fixture identity + PIT-safe evidence packet). No web search, no external football lookup.
transport_preflight_requirement: hasattr(client,'converse') asserted before first paid call (defect D4 guard).
input_token_bound_proof: Claude tokenization is byte-level BPE, so a request of B UTF-8 bytes has at most B input tokens. The reservation uses the frozen ceiling MAX_REQUEST_UTF8_BYTES as the per-call input-token bound and the runner refuses any request whose canonical bytes exceed the ceiling; therefore input tokens are provably <= reserved bound. No empirical ratio, no rounding down.
response_receipt_policy: Persist the raw provider Converse envelope (stopReason, usage, output message, resolved modelId) plus request_sha256 to a durable per-fixture receipt file BEFORE classifying. A trustworthy receipt means the fixture received its one treatment.
neutralization_policy: Per-fixture point-in-time-safe evidence packet is materialized by the live pipeline; no post-target field, market, outcome, future lineup, or future injury is admissible. Item 6 formalizer rejects provider-unsafe/future-leakage concepts. This execution config adds no scientific field and does not build the packet.
